# RE4 Remake Merchant Shop

## 1. Quantity Selection
- No quantity selector exists
- Each item purchase is single-unit only
- Buying 10 grenades = pressing buy button 10 times
- Stack purchases (like ammo) auto-add one stack per transaction

## 2. Feedback
- **Add to cart**: Not applicable (instant purchase)
- **Buy**: 
  - Metallic "ka-ching" sound (~200ms)
  - Item icon briefly flashes white then slides right into inventory display
  - Currency number decreases with satisfying tick-down animation
  - Merchant nods or reacts with short voice line
- **Sell**:
  - Different, lighter metallic sound
  - Item slides left from inventory
  - Currency ticks up
  - Merchant comments ("I'll buy it at a high price!")

## 3. Character Framing
- Merchant occupies left third of screen, seated at his case/table
- Constant animated idle (smoking pipe, examining goods)
- Item grid center-right
- Player inventory bottom-right
- Merchant never obscures the shop grid; fully separated zones

## 4. N/A (RE4 has no ledger interface)

## 5. Satisfaction Mechanics
- **Instant transactions**: Zero load, zero confirmation dialog for single buys
- **Rapid repeat**: Hold button to repeatedly buy single items without menu exit
- **Spatial consistency**: Item positions don't shift after purchase if still available
- **Immediate inventory update**: See stacks grow in real-time during purchase spree
- **Audio stacking**: Buy fast enough, sounds overlap creating rewarding audio cascade
- **Tactile sell-all**: Can dump entire inventory categories rapidly

## 6. Phone Translation Issues
- **Two-handed grid navigation**: Precise cursor control + simultaneous confirm button required
- **Information density**: Comparative stats (current weapon vs. upgrade) shown side-by-side, needs horizontal space
- **Merchant character presence**:占 33% of screen real estate, would crush vertical phone layout


---

# RE Village Duke Shop

## 1. Quantity Selection
- Appears when buying stackable items (ammo, materials, food)
- Vertical numeric stepper right of item name in purchase dialog
- Three inputs: +1 button (top), -1 button (bottom), or stick/d-pad left-right
- Current quantity displayed as large numeral between buttons
- Max quantity grayed out when insufficient funds

## 2. Feedback
- **Add to cart**: N/A (also instant purchase)
- **Buy**:
  - Heavy coin-drop sound (~300ms with reverb tail)
  - Ledger entry writes in with ink-scratch sound effect
  - Running total updates with brief golden glow
  - Duke chuckles or says "Excellent choice" (voice line ~1-2 sec)
  - Purchased item quantity number scales up 120% then back (elastic ease, ~400ms total)
- **Sell**:
  - Coin-drop sound, higher pitch
  - Lei total glows and increases
  - Item fades from ledger with page-turn rustle

## 3. Character Framing
- Duke occupies entire left half of screen, seated behind his wagon counter
- Direct eye contact with camera/player
- Shop interface is diegetic ledger/book on counter in foreground (right half)
- Duke gestures toward book when navigating sections
- His hands occasionally enter frame to point at items

## 4. Duke Ledger Treatment
- **Visual**: Aged parchment texture with torn/burned edges
- **Typography**: Serif font resembling hand-inked merchant script (~14pt for items, ~18pt for categories)
- **Borders**: Ornate corner flourishes, dark brown ink
- **Categories**: Separated by decorative divider lines (scrollwork)
- **Running total**: 
  - Bottom-right corner of ledger
  - "Total: [amount] Lei" in slightly larger bold serif
  - Golden coin icon left of number
  - Updates with brief flash and number count-up animation (not instant)
  - Previous total briefly visible as ghost/strike-through during transition

## 5. Satisfaction Mechanics
- **Quantity batching**: Buy 50 pistol rounds in one transaction vs. 50 button presses
- **Ledger permanence**: Purchased items briefly remain visible as "owned" before fading, reinforcing completion
- **Analog quantity scrubbing**: Hold stick left/right to smoothly ramp quantity with accelerating scroll speed
- **Audio layering**: Coin sound + ink scratch + Duke voice + music sting = rich feedback stack
- **Visual weight**: Lei total uses bold golden numerals with coin icon; feels monetarily significant
- **Category memory**: Interface remembers your position when switching categories (no scroll reset)

## 6. Phone Translation Issues
- **Quantity stepper**: ±1 buttons would need to be enlarged for thumb accuracy, eating vertical space
- **Dual information streams**: Watching Duke's character animations while reading ledger requires wide FOV; vertical scroll would separate them
- **Lei total placement**: Bottom-right corner unreachable for one-handed thumb without awkward grip shift
- **Ledger aspect ratio**: Designed for 16:9 landscape; portrait mode would require scrolling the "page" itself
- **Analog quantity scrubbing**: Requires sustained directional hold + visual tracking; thumb fatigue on glass
